entities.name: GlmU query protein
observations: 476-aa sequence; strongest reviewed Swiss-Prot homolog is Acidovorax sp. GlmU A1W3Q7 (79.4% identity, 99.6% query coverage; E=3.97e-262).
Strong-homology-supported bifunctional enzyme: N-terminal UDP-GlcNAc diphosphorylase (EC 2.7.7.23) and C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.157).
Homolog annotations support Mg2+ binding and cytoplasmic localization; these are inferred for this query by close homology.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 50,024.6 Da; pI 6.924; instability index 28.60; GRAVY 0.0139.

entities.name: GlcN-1-P acetylation
observations: GlmU homolog annotation supports alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA → N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+ (Rhea RHEA:13725).

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc formation
observations: GlmU homolog annotation supports N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ → UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:13509).
